children: Elon Musk said he expects to launch rockets from a planned "Starbase Louisiana" site in less than three years. The new site, in a coastal area of the state known for duck hunting, is anticipated to be far larger than the Starbase site outside Brownsville, Texas.

In response to a question from an individual investor about his "current confidence level" about a Louisiana launch in 2029, he said the company's internal goal is 2028 before adding that 2029 was "highly likely."
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).

title: SpaceX Expects to Launch Rockets From Louisiana in 2029 — WSJ
